cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Count What I Did
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the practical work, time, or inconvenience you contributed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you call it a quick shop, count the carrying: twelve bags up six flights. Purchase time is not delivery time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I know. Sit down and I'll put everything away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Keep the peas separate in your account; they required a second trip.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you get two rests. I'll make tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say 'two trips' when you tell the others. Two rests sounds like poor stamina. Please report the work, not just the recovery.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 purchase/delivery distinction and A5 work/recovery correction make expert accounting a means to claim credit.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 unpacking offer leads to A3 uncounted second trip; B4 double rest leads to A5 reporting correction.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 help willingly; A seeks accurate recognition rather than mere physical assistance.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4 generous double rest into concern about how effort will be reported.

specificity.evidence: A1 bags and stairs are clear, but A3 your account sounds like a ledger B has not offered to keep.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 keep the peas separate in your account is stiff compared with B ordinary unpacking offer.
